name: TokenProbe
title: Conjurer
milestone: began the quest for the Orb.

payload.name: TokenProbe
payload.title: the Conjurer
payload.doom_desc:
A malevolent fate is gathering around you. If your Doom reaches 100%, you will be afflicted by a random bane and your Doom will reset to 0. Banes have diverse negative effects that can significantly endanger your character for an extended period of time.

Both Doom and Banes are only cured by gaining experience, though Banes typically last much longer.

spells.name: Magic Dart
spells.desc: Fires a small bolt of magical energy which never misses.

mutations.name: explore regen
mutations.desc: You regain HP and MP as you explore.

inventory.name: +0 robe
inventory.description: A large, loose-fitting, wide-sleeved outer garment made of light cloth. It offers little protection against physical harm, but does not hinder evasion or spellcasting.

inventory.name: potion of magic
inventory.description: A valuable potion which grants an infusion of magical energy.

slots.label: Barding
slots.reason: You can't fit into that!

slots.label: Gizmo
slots.reason: You lack an exoframe to install that in.
